Together 322.5π + 112.5π = 435π ≈ 3.14 × 435 = 1365.9. (Counting one circle covers only the bottom.) So 1365.9 ft².

problems.explain: A prism is the area of its end times its length. The end is a triangle with the two shorter sides at the right angle, so ½ × 5 × 12 = 30; times the length, 30 × 7 = 210. (5 × 12 × 7 = 420 is the box around it, twice as much; the longest side, 13, is not used.) So 210 in³.
